shadcn.note: Pinned CLI version for MCP stdio. npx downloads the package; there is no artifactSha256.

context7.note: Remote MCP. No auth secret is stored by this installer.

design-bank.note: Not vendored in git. Fourth-priority bootstrap fallback after a valid local bank, OPENCODE_DESIGN_BANK_URL+SHA256, and the Drive ZIP pin in lib/design_v2/bootstrap_sources.json.

stitch.note: Remote MCP. Screen and mock comp generation only. No secrets stored in git; configured via STITCH_API_KEY environment variable or OAuth.

reticle.note: Optional visual perception MCP. Server licensed under FSL-1.1-ALv2; not vendored. Enabled via opencode-he reticle enable.

ui-skills.note: Optional remote MCP for design skill lookup only. Enabled via opencode-he ui-skills enable.

markitdown.note: Optional MCP via uvx --from markitdown-mcp==0.1.8. Not vendored. No Azure keys. Enabled via opencode-he markitdown enable.

scrapling.note: Optional MCP via uvx --from scrapling[ai]==0.4.15 scrapling mcp. Not vendored. Enabled via opencode-he scrapling enable. Do not run scrapling install (requires sudo / playwright install-deps).

agent-reach.note: POINTER_ONLY, not installed by OCH. PyPI name agent-reach belongs to another project; install via git URL with pipx if desired. Do not run agent-reach install --system.

browser-act.note: Three supported execution modes (chrome, stealth-fresh, stealth-fixed). Never chrome-direct. Host CLI pinned 1.3.0.

impeccable.note: Adapted reference set with strict overlay gates (Design V2 atom shortlisting, taste-guard 4-tier, found-this-design world pin, BANK_MISS != generate, email design merge). No runtime plugin download.

emil-design-eng.note: Emil Kowalski design engineering principles and motion doctrines merged into single specialist without catalog bloat (motion, apple-principles, native-motion, interface-feel).

email-design-sources.note: Merged into skills/impeccable/reference/email.md; zero new allowlist names.

axi.note: Surfaces for gh-axi and chrome-devtools-axi under 4-door browser hierarchy.

scroll-craft.note: Adapted skill and engine with deterministic cleanup and split mechanism/theme CSS. No KIE/Higgsfield/Playwright core path. Worldflight runtime removed; Continuous World handed to scroll-world.

scroll-world.note: Continuous camera fly-through landing with vanilla-JS scrub engine and seam QA calibration. Paid video backends degrade to NOT_CONFIGURED.

pstack.note: Evaluated at tip 23e4138 (pstack 0.15.6). Pstack selected skills retained with OpenCode host adaptation. Rejected upstream: poteto-mode, /how, /automate-me, /make-bot-ui, /bro, swarm, autopilot loops (ralph-loop, orchestrate, continual-learning), and ~/.cursor/rules/pstack-models.mdc model configuration.

playwright-cli.note: OCBF exploratory browser QA adapter; isolated sessions, default headless Chromium.

taste-skill.note: Selectively adapted into Impeccable reference/taste-guard.md and reference/taste/ modules.

anti-slop.note: Vendored rule snapshot for TS/JS projects with 4 modes (audit, recommended, strict, custom) and opt-in Effect rules.

json-render.note: First-party skill wrapper. npm packages not vendored. Experimental Jev composition not ported.

deck-design.note: First-party skill wrapper. Upstream 62-type HTML/PPTX packs not vendored.

pageindex.note: First-party skill wrapper. SDK/Cloud/MCP not vendored and not core MCP.

business-motion-film.note: First-party skill wrapper. Pointers reference pinned upstream files; large reference packs not vendored. Rendered via hyperframes.

motion-designer.note: Merged into skills/business-motion-film as product-film mode. Real app UI in device chrome, seek(t) frame determinism, 4-still approval gate. Models and plugin not vendored.

9router.note: Multi-provider LLM gateway and capability skills. First-party stub in skills/ninerouter; capability skills fetched on-demand; not an extra core MCP.
